sections.kicker: Prepared for Nourished by Pam by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Pam has a voice people trust. The bio lists topics instead of using it.
sections.keep: The grid type. Cream serif headlines over warm photos look like one person's kitchen.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things

pins.quote: herbs, nutrition & seasonal habits for women
pins.why: Herbs, nutrition and habits are what every wellness account covers, so nothing says why Pam.
pins.how: Lead with the angle only she has, then the topics.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: She is filed with every other herbalism account.

pins.what: One line in the bio carries a real personality.
pins.why: It is warm, specific and a little funny, and it is the only line that sounds like Pam.
pins.how: Build the bio around this line.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The best line sits fourth in a list of four.

pins.quote: still figuring a lot of it out as I go
pins.what: The captions keep saying she is still learning.
pins.why: It is honest, but it asks readers to trust a student instead of an expert with a master's degree.
pins.how: Say what she knows first and keep the student angle as flavour.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: Readers who want an expert do not stay.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Nourished by Pam. I spent some time on what people see first. Three things stood out.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Nourished by Pam's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
